summary: Aspekta (SIL OFL 1.1, Ivo Dolenc) becomes the single typeface, replacing Manrope as the distributed default and retiring Saans entirely (ADR 0007, supersedes the face choice in 0003). --ui-font-body and --ui-font-display both default to Aspekta; the roles stay separate tokens. New font-aspekta registry item ships the @font-face CSS + OFL text; the variable woff2 lives in the repo and is fetched by URL (attempting to inline it exposed that the JSON transport corrupts binary content — the registry pipeline now rejects binary files at both validate and build). Licensing allowlist now aspekta-only, so any Manrope or Saans straggler fails CI. service-portal drops its planned Saans display-role override in Phase 4.

migration.manual: Consumers with the (never-shipped) Manrope item: add @bydiorama/font-aspekta, update any local font-family overrides to Aspekta, delete Manrope files. No codemod needed — no consumer installed the previous font item.
